treasury_hub_subtitle: Assemble payment orders from outstanding fees and track gateway settlement
treasury_billing_setup_subtitle: Treasury receipt catalog and service billing rules
treasury_quantity_fixed_hint: Always bills exactly one unit, e.g. a single transcript.
treasury_quantity_caller_hint: The requesting module decides the quantity, e.g. credit hours.
treasury_student_search_placeholder: Search students by name, code, or national ID…
treasury_student_search_failed: Student search failed. Please try again.
treasury_pick_student_hint: Find the student to view their outstanding fees and collect payments.
treasury_all_settled_hint: This student has no unpaid fees right now.
treasury_fees_load_failed: Could not load the student's fees.
treasury_multi_currency_hint: Fees are billed in more than one currency. A payment order can only contain fees of a single currency.
treasury_currency_locked_hint: This order already contains {{currency}} fees — finish or clear the selection first.
treasury_builder_empty_hint: Tick fees on the list to add them to the order.
treasury_create_needs_fees: Select at least one fee to continue.
treasury_create_needs_gateway: Choose a payment gateway to continue.
treasury_order_created_toast: Order created — ready to initiate payment.
treasury_no_orders_hint: Payment orders will appear here once fees are submitted for payment.
treasury_order_created_title: Order assembled — not sent to the gateway yet.
treasury_order_created_hint: Initiate payment to get a checkout link, or cancel to release the fees back to the outstanding pool.
treasury_initiate_failed: Payment initiation failed. The gateway may be unavailable — try again.
treasury_initiated_toast: Payment session ready — share the link with the student.
treasury_cancel_order_detail: The fees will be released back to the outstanding pool. Only orders not yet sent to the gateway can be cancelled.
treasury_order_cancelled_toast: Order cancelled — fees returned to the outstanding pool.
treasury_payment_link_expiry_note: Payment links expire roughly 30 minutes after initiation. If the link expires unpaid, the fees return to the outstanding pool automatically.
treasury_payment_failed_toast: The gateway reported the payment as failed. Fees were released back.
treasury_payment_expired_toast: The payment window expired. Fees were released back.
treasury_order_paid_hint: All fees in this order are marked as paid.
treasury_order_released_hint: The fees were released back to the outstanding pool — a new order can be created at any time.
treasury_receipts_sync_note: Prices are owned by the HU Treasury system and refreshed automatically every few hours.
treasury_receipts_load_failed: Could not load the receipt catalog.
treasury_no_receipts_hint: Receipts appear after the first successful sync with the HU Treasury system.
treasury_live_feed_failed: Could not reach the HU Treasury system.
treasury_in_sync: All {{count}} live receipts match the synced catalog.
treasury_drift_note: Differences resolve automatically on the next scheduled sync.
treasury_mappings_explainer: Mappings link a student service to a Treasury receipt so requesting the service automatically raises a fee at the Treasury price.
treasury_no_mappings_hint: Create a mapping to bill a student service through the Treasury.
treasury_service_select_hint: Only active services without an active mapping are listed.
treasury_receipt_select_hint: The receipt defines the unit price charged for the service.
treasury_mapping_form_incomplete: Choose both a service and a receipt.
treasury_mapping_preview: Students requesting "{{service}}" will be billed {{amount}} per unit.
treasury_mapping_preview_caller: The final amount is multiplied by the quantity supplied by the request.
treasury_deactivate_mapping_detail: New requests for this service will no longer raise a Treasury fee. Existing fees are not affected.
treasury_pay_at_office_hint: These fees can be paid at the university treasury office.
